Knowles Nursery School
Quality education right from the start
Come and see our Nursery School in action
Staff and Governors wish you a warm welcome to Knowles Nursery School. We are a stand-alone state-funded Maintained Nursery School and as such provide the highest level of staff expertise and qualifications which include qualified teachers. We admit children from the term after they turn two years old. Children come to us from Bletchley as well as other areas in Milton Keynes. Children then move on from us to a range of different Primary Schools across Milton Keynes the year they turn five.
Within our school young children learn through carefully planned play experiences in a specialist environment that enables them to flourish as individuals. We are a welcoming and happy school, very much at the heart of our local community.
We offer a range of specialist services for children and families such as a Speech and Language Therapist who works with us once a fortnight, specialist resources for children with additional needs, health visitor clinics at Saplings Children's Centre, a range of stay and play sessions for children from birth to five, welfare support and much much more. We strive to be a one stop community hub for families.
If you are considering Nursery Education for your child, then we would encourage you to browse our website or better still come and visit us! We welcome visits to the Nursery school by appointment, so please telephone us and we will arrange for a member of our Early Years team to show you and your child around.
I am extremely proud to lead the Nursery School and provide the youngest children in our education system the very best possible start in life.
Natalie Fowler Headteacher
" Committed staff and teachers who deliver a variety of educational and learning activities. Friendly and approachable."

Admission
If your child is eligible to receive Two Year Old Funding we are able to admit them into the Nursery School for 15 hours per week to be taken either morning or afternoon sessions Monday - Friday starting the term after they turn two years of age. Two Year old funding is decided by the Local Authority and family circumstances must match specified criteria. If you need support with applying for the Two Year Old funding, please visit the team at Saplings Family Centre.
For children who are not eligible for this funding, they will become eligible to attend the Nursery School the term after their third birthday. Again we offer 15 hours per week to be taken either morning or afternoon sessions Monday - Friday until it is time for them to start Primary School.
If you would like to receive more information please click here to send us an admission enquiry. You can register your child for a place once they reach the age of 18 months old or you are notified by the Local Authority of your eligibility for Two Year old funding. Once registered, you will receive a letter offering you a place for your child approximately one term before their start date. There are no fees to pay because we are a Local Authority Maintained Nursery School. Have a look at the Prospectus page to find out more.
Prior to starting at nursery school the Saplings Family Centre has a range of Stay and Play sessions which will help your child get used to the nursery environment.
Nursery Session times:
Children attend Knowles Nursery School for five mornings or five afternoons per week. Times are 8.45 am - 11.45 am or 12.30 pm - 3.30 pm. Please indicate whether you prefer mornings or afternoons and we will try to meet your needs if possible, although we cannot guarantee this.
We offer a limited number of 30 hour offer spaces and these do get filled up quickly. For us to offer a place for this entitlement you will need to meet specified criteria and provide us with your 11 digit eligibility code. All 30 hour offer children must bring a packed lunch each day and session time are from 8:45am - 2:45pm
We also offer a number of paid places so that parents can pay for a longer session. Please click here to see our Funded and Private Places Parent Contract Policy

30 Hour Extended Offer for 2, 3 & 4 Year olds.
We offer a limited number of 30 hour Extended Free Early Years Education places to eligible families with 2, 3 & 4 year old children. Priority for these places will be given to our existing families first and then families who have already accepted a place for September.
Session times for the 30 hours free education will be 8:45am until 2:45pm. Children will be required to bring a packed lunch and named sun cream with them. If parents wish to extend the session until 3:30pm which is when the afternoon session finishes for children accessing 15 hours of universal entitlement, they can do so at a cost of £6.50 per day.
It is the responsibility of parents to check if they are eligible and are then required to bring their National Insurance Number and the 11 digit code they are given from the online checker into the School office to secure a 30 hour place.
To see if you are eligible for the extended 30 hour offer please click here.
The entitlement can be also be accessed across more than one provider. This means that a family who is eligible for the 30 hour offer could still attend the Nursery School and then choose to use the other 15 hours with either a childminder or another independent childcare provider.
Please click here for some more information regarding the 30 hour offer on the Milton Keynes Council webpage.
If you have any questions please do not hesitate to speak to a member of staff or Saplings Family Centre.

pageCache.pageTitle: Time for Two's | Knowles Nursery School
pageCache.text:
Time for Two's
If your child is eligible for the Government funded Time for Two's 15 hours of free Early Education, your child can start with us the term after they have turned 2 years old.
Once your child is attending Nursery School, they can stay with us until they move on to Primary School.
We have 16 spaces for 2-year-old children in both the morning and afternoon sessions and these places fill up quickly so we would advise you to get your child's name on our admissions list as soon as you can.
Parents must check their child's eligibility by going onto an online portal, where once you have put in your details you will be informed if you can access the Time for Two's funding. Please note that in order to be able to do this you must have an email address. If you need support with this, please make an appointment at Saplings Family Centre and they would be pleased to help you.
Please click here for the Time for Two's information page and to start the application process for the free funded hours.
If you need support making the online application form please drop into either the Nursery School or Saplings Family Centre where we will endeavour to support you through the process.
GET IN TOUCH!

Our Curriculum
Our curriculum meets all of the statutory requirements of the revised Early Years Foundation Stage (September 2021) and has been sensitively designed to meet the needs of our community and the children who attend our Nursery School. We strive to broaden and develop all children's knowledge, skills and instil a love of learning and lifelong skills.
We have taken into consideration that our children span the ages of 2 - 4 years old and that their learning needs can vary a great deal in this age range. We have also considered that children vary in experience. Our curriculum is broad and flexible with key milestones planned for children to achieve, but also includes sensitive reasonable adjustments and additional support if it is needed.
We are a fully inclusive setting and try our utmost to meet the needs of all pupils whilst striving for the best possible learning experiences and outcomes for all. We work in close partnership with parents and a range of external agencies such as health visitors, speech and language therapists, inclusion and intervention workers and local primary schools to name a few. We are also very fortunate to have the Saplings Children's Centre on site with us so that we can provide a wide range of support for the whole family.
We believe that young children learn best when they are playing and directly involved in the learning, are actively emerged in first-hand experiences and when they feel happy and safe.

The Saplings Family Centre
Saplings Family Centre serves the areas of: Bow Brickhill, Central Bletchley, Eaton Leys, Fenny Stratford, Lakes Estate, Little Brickhill, Newton Leys and Water Eaton.
Our Centre is a ‘one stop shop’ for all of our community which has a positive impact on the lives of individual young children and their families.
You will find the following members of staff at The Saplings
Amanda Fisher -Family Centre Head
Charlotte Pearson - Enhanced Practitioner
Laura Horton - Practitoner
Mala Ali - Business Support
Jenna Cooper- Business Support
The Saplings is open Monday - Thursday 8:30am - 4:30pm and Friday 8:30am - 4:00pm
To view the current timetable at Saplings please click here
Email: saplingschildrenscentre@milton-keynes.gov.uk
Address: The Saplings SureStart Children's Centre, Knowles Nursery School, Queensway, Bletchley, Milton Keynes, MK2 2HB
Please note that the small car park is for staff only and, regrettably, there is no parking for parents. We hope you will be able to find a parking space nearby or alternatively walk down to see us or use public transport.
